summary: FingerMotion filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a September 3, 2026 press release announcing a non-binding three-party memorandum of understanding with Lyken AI Computing Inc. and BlueFlare Energy Solutions Inc. for a demand-to-capacity matching framework across Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan, tied to modular behind-the-meter AI computing capacity. The MOU creates no exclusivity, capacity reservation, or funding obligation and does not amend existing agreements. FingerMotion owns 9.9% of Lyken; Alset AI holds 90.1%. Watch for definitive agreements and any capital commitment, as none are currently binding.
